principles: A0 is direct self-report only; never infer it from A1-A5.
A2 and A3 are primarily issue-position evidence cards in V1.1; do not force sparse answers into precise multi-axis scores.
A4 is primarily a practice-pattern evidence card set.
A5 may produce a low-confidence reflexivity summary plus evidence, but must expose item count.
Never sum A0-A5 into a single ideological score.
Never use A-layer to automatically admit, reject, rank, or allocate roles.

exploratorySignals.purpose: future pilot calibration / consistency analysis only

reporting.A0: show respondent's selected self-description; never rewrite it as an inferred identity
reporting.A1: show correct/answered and a cautious familiarity label; with only 3 sampled items, state low precision
reporting.A2_A3: show the 3 answered issues and selected positions; optional neutral thematic summary only
reporting.A4: show the 2 practice-pattern responses as descriptive evidence
reporting.A5: show a cautious reflexivity summary only if both sampled items align; otherwise say mixed/insufficient evidence
